AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
